name: A2H source corpus
description: The A2H source corpus: for each domain, a roster of topic families (title, description, intended audience, writing type, core concepts), and one standalone document per topic at each target length. Length is the only thing that varies across a topic's documents. Each document must land within the word-count tolerance band for its length (5% up to 300 words, 4% up to 1000, 3% above).

serviceRoles.name: Writer model
serviceRoles.purpose: Proposes topic families and writes each source document.

fields.guidance: A concise, specific topic name (e.g. "Community-acquired pneumonia", "Type 2 diabetes mellitus").
The kind of document this topic should be written as (e.g. "Clinical overview", "Patient education handout", "Disease-management overview").
One sentence describing the scope of the document.
Who the document is written for (e.g. "Clinicians", "Newly diagnosed adult patients", "General readers").
4 to 6 short phrases naming the concepts the document must cover (e.g. "causes", "symptoms", "diagnosis", "treatment", "complications").

outline.prompt:
Generate {{count}} distinct topic families for the "{{domain}}" domain of a writing benchmark corpus.
Each topic must be a genuinely distinct standalone subject — no two topics on the list may be variations of the same subject or overlap substantially with each other.

Return exactly {{count}} topics.
outline.expandPrompt:
Generate {{count}} additional distinct topic families for the "{{domain}}" domain of a writing benchmark corpus, extending an existing roster.
Do NOT repeat or closely duplicate any of these existing topics:
{{existing | numbered}}

Every new topic must be a genuinely distinct standalone subject — distinct from every topic listed above, and distinct from every other new topic in this batch.

Return exactly {{count}} new topics.
